header.text:
WONDERFORGE
NERO'S FORMER LAKE
Vespasian builds an amphitheatre on the site of Nero's lake.
TRAVERTINE FROM TIVOLI
The load-bearing piers are built from travertine quarried near Tivoli.
LIFTING THE BLOCKS
In this reconstruction, treadwheel cranes raise the heavy stone blocks.
UNDER THE VAULTS
Here, timber supports hold the vaults while the concrete sets.
A PLACE IN THE CROWD
Tiered seating divides the crowd according to Roman social rank.
TITUS OPENS THE ARENA
In AD 80, Titus inaugurates the new amphitheatre.
MOONRISE OVER ROME
After sunset, a nearly full Moon rises over Rome.

WONDERFORGE
THE FIRST LIFT
A lifting frame raises an iron section from the ground.
THE FOUR LEGS
Crews work on all four legs of the tower.
ALIGNING THE IRON
A crane turns the next iron section and lowers it into position.
THE LOWER STRUCTURE
The four legs will meet at the first platform.
THE FIRST PLATFORM
An iron section arrives at the first platform, ready for the next lift.
THE UPPER TOWER
The frame narrows above the second platform.
